rag.text:
Test: TC-1798 — Feature area - Security - AppAdmin - Visibility of the License tab in Technical Configuration- log as AppAdmin
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-47 Feature area - Security
Labels: teamtree

Steps:
1. Navigate to Jira Administration - User Management tab
   Expected: User management tab is displayed
2. Search for userName and click on it
   Data: Atlassian Server
userName = appadmin

Atlassian Cloud
userName = testlab.1@softwareplant.com
   Expected: Account information is displayed
3. Click Manage groups button
   Expected: Additional window to manage gropus is displayed
4. Search for jira-administrators group and click Join selected groups button
   Expected: User is added to selected group. Jira-administrators group is displayed in Applications and groups section
5. In new tab log in as appAdmin
   Data: Atlassian Server:
login = appadmin
password = sdfoijj

Atlassian Cloud:
login = testlab.1@softwareplant.com
password = alamakota123
   Expected: The user can be logged on successfully.
6. Navigate to Jira Administration > Manage Apps > BigTemplate configuration > License
   Expected: The License page loads. The folLowing information is displayed:
 - Feature Plan
 - Status
 - License ID
7. Navigate to Jira Administration > Manage Apps > BigPicture configuration > License
   Expected: The License page loads. The folLowing information is displayed:
 - Feature Plan
 - Status
 - License ID
8. Navigate to Jira Administration > Manage Apps > BigGantt configuration > License
   Expected: The License page loads. The folLowing information is displayed:
 - Feature Plan
 - Status
 - License ID
